Mailroom sandwich bites.d: Ham, cheddar and pickle on buttered white bread, crusts off, cut in fingers and wrapped in wax paper.
Mailroom sandwich bites.note: Employee Cafeteria, lower level, next to the mailroom.

Kansas corn fritters.d: Sweet kernels and spring onion in a light batter, fried golden. Sour cream on the side.

Executive rib eye.d: Dry-brined, seared hard and basted in butter with thyme and garlic, rested, then sliced.

Kansas apple pie.d: Cinnamon and sugar under a double crust, served with vanilla ice cream.

Martini.d: Stirred over ice with dry vermouth, strained into a frozen glass, lemon twist.
Martini.note: Bar service from 5:30 PM for anyone working late.
